name: @li-langverse/cursor-agents
description: Local Cursor SDK agent runner for li-langverse (mock backend for CI)

scripts.agents:async-swarm: npm run build && node dist/cli/async-swarm.js start
scripts.briefing:enrich: npm run build && LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node dist/cli/enrich-briefing.js
scripts.test:full: npm run build && LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk LI_STACK_SKIP_SUPABASE=1 CURSOR_MOCK=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 'dist/**/*.test.js' 'dist/e2e/*.e2e.js' && node scripts/test-log-timestamps.mjs
scripts.test:db-api: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/db-api.e2e.js
scripts.test:live-stream-db: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_E2E_USE_SUPABASE=1 node --test dist/e2e/agent-live-stream-supabase.e2e.js
scripts.test:playwright: npm run build && cd dashboard-ui && npm install && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:playwright:mock: npm run build && cd dashboard-ui && npm install && npm run test:e2e:mock
scripts.test:playwright:integration: npm run build && cd dashboard-ui && npm install && LI_PLAYWRIGHT_USE_SUPABASE=1 npm run test:e2e:integration
scripts.test:e2e:all-leaves: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/agent-all-leaves.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:demo-repo: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk LI_RESEARCH_PARALLEL=1 node --test dist/e2e/demo-repo-parallel-agents.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:goal-lic: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/goal-lic-workflow.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:run-all-handoff: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/run-all-handoff.e2e.js dist/lanes/run-handoff-phases-force.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:agent-audit: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/agent-function-audit.e2e.js dist/e2e/agent-role-audit.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:all-leaves-sdk: npm run build && env -u CURSOR_MOCK LI_E2E_SDK=1 LI_E2E_SDK_ALL_LEAVES=1 LI_LIVE_TRACE_FLUSH_MS=0 LI_WORKSPACE_SWEEP_FORCE_LLM=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/e2e/agent-all-leaves-sdk.e2e.js
scripts.test:dashboard-api: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk LI_PERSIST_MOCK_RUNS=1 node --test dist/e2e/db-api.e2e.js dist/e2e/worker-swarm.e2e.js dist/e2e/dashboard-api.e2e.js dist/e2e/dashboard-live-runs.e2e.js dist/e2e/dashboard-run-trace.e2e.js dist/e2e/dashboard-next-tabs.e2e.js dist/e2e/agent-function-audit.e2e.js
scripts.test:worker-swarm: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/worker-swarm.e2e.js
scripts.test:dashboard-ui: node scripts/check-dashboard-no-motion.mjs && npm --prefix dashboard-ui run build
scripts.test:agent-matrix: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/agent-matrix.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:slow: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/agent-matrix.e2e.js dist/e2e/agent-parallel-pool.e2e.js dist/e2e/agent-activity-pipeline.e2e.js dist/lanes/research-lane.test.js
scripts.test:swarm-full: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/swarm-full.e2e.js dist/e2e/worker-swarm.e2e.js dist/e2e/swarm-handoff.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk node --test dist/e2e/heap.e2e.js dist/e2e/swarm-handoff.e2e.js dist/e2e/swarm-full.e2e.js dist/e2e/worker-swarm.e2e.js dist/e2e/agent-matrix.e2e.js dist/e2e/async-handoff.e2e.js dist/e2e/run-all-handoff.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:sdk: npm run build && env -u CURSOR_MOCK LI_E2E_SDK=1 node --test dist/e2e/sdk-live.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:sdk-parallel: npm run build && env -u CURSOR_MOCK LI_E2E_SDK=1 LI_E2E_SDK_PARALLEL=1 node --test dist/e2e/sdk-parallel-live.e2e.js
scripts.test:sdk-lock: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/backends/sdk-session-lock.test.js dist/backends/sdk-session-lock.stale.test.js dist/e2e/sdk-parallel-lock.e2e.js dist/e2e/agent-parallel-pool.e2e.js
scripts.ci: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 npm test && node dist/cli/run-agent.js --agent orchestrator --mock --dry-run && node dist/cli/supervisor.js --once --mock
